Context: 1. When Admissible

6. Once in a calendar year, while returning from leave from a place in a remote locality or to a place in a remote locality.
7. Once in a calendar year, to officials domiciled in the Union Territories of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, while proceeding on leave to their home town in another Island on the Union Territory and returning from home town. - GIO (1).  
Temporary Transfer.JT as on tour, is admissible.
